# Progress Together

Progress Together is a private tutoring service founded by MaryEllen.
Our philosophy is built on patience, encouragement, and genuine connection to help students unlock their potential.

## Services Offered
- Reading Comprehension (Phonics, vocabulary, critical reading)
- Writing Skills (Grammar, essay structuring, creative writing)
- Foundational Math (Number sense, operations, problem-solving strategies)

## Core Values
- Expertise
- Empathy
- Partnership
